Materials.Name: Materials
Materials.Description: Salvage, sorted and ready for the printer.

Items.Title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built (Becky Chambers)
Items.Description: A tea monk and a robot walk into the wilderness to ask what people need. You read it slowly, on purpose.

Items.Title: Station Eleven (Emily St. John Mandel)
Items.Description: A travelling theatre troupe after the end of everything. It used to read like a warning. Now it reads like a letter from a friend.

Items.Title: The Left Hand of Darkness (Ursula K. Le Guin)
Items.Description: A long walk across the ice beside someone you don't understand yet. By the end, you do.

Items.Title: Middlemarch (George Eliot)
Items.Description: Eight hundred pages of ordinary lives in a small town. The ordinary lives turn out to be the whole point.

Items.Title: The Remains of the Day (Kazuo Ishiguro)
Items.Description: A butler drives through the countryside, almost saying what he means, mile after mile.

Items.Title: Music for Airports (Brian Eno)
Items.Description: Built to make waiting rooms bearable. It works on orbiters too.

Items.Title: Kind of Blue (Miles Davis)
Items.Description: Unhurried and cool, like the musicians had all the time in the world. Maybe they did.

Items.Title: Blue (Joni Mitchell)
Items.Description: Just a voice, a dulcimer, and nothing held back.

Items.Title: In Rainbows (Radiohead)
Items.Description: Warm and restless at once. Best heard with the lights low.

Items.Title: Pet Sounds (The Beach Boys)
Items.Description: Sunlit harmonies with something aching underneath.

Items.Title: The Disintegration Loops (William Basinski)
Items.Description: Old tape loops slowly crumbling as they play. Beautiful in a way that's hard to explain up here.

Items.Title: Carrie & Lowell (Sufjan Stevens)
Items.Description: Quiet songs about grief, sung barely above a whisper.

Items.Title: Selected Ambient Works 85-92 (Aphex Twin)
Items.Description: Machines dreaming in soft focus. Fitting company.

Items.Title: Vespertine (Bjork)
Items.Description: Music boxes, whispers and snowfall. It sounds like being indoors on a winter night.

Items.Title: Moon Safari (Air)
Items.Description: Lounge-y and starry-eyed. Someone imagined space would feel like this, and sometimes it does.

Items.Title: WALL-E
Items.Description: A small robot tidies a dead Earth and falls in love. You try not to take it personally.

Items.Title: My Neighbor Totoro
Items.Description: Two sisters, a new house, and a forest spirit at the bus stop in the rain. Nothing bad happens. That's the gift.

Items.Title: Paddington 2
Items.Description: If we're kind and polite, the world will be right. Hard to argue with.

Items.Title: Spirited Away
Items.Description: A girl works in a bathhouse for spirits and doesn't forget her own name.

Items.Title: The Iron Giant
Items.Description: A giant machine decides what kind of machine it wants to be.

Items.Title: Arrival
Items.Description: Learning a language that changes how you see time. You'd make the same choice, too.

Items.Title: Paris, Texas
Items.Description: A man walks out of the desert and slowly finds his way back to people.

Items.Title: Stalker
Items.Description: Three men cross a forbidden Zone toward a room that grants wishes. Long, quiet, and green.

Items.Title: Tampopo
Items.Description: A truck driver helps a widow perfect her ramen. Mostly it's a love letter to eating.

Items.Title: Moonstruck
Items.Description: Brooklyn, opera, a full moon, and a family too loud to be unhappy for long.
